description: A plastic printed copy of Glock 19, a popular handgun already known for its mostly-plastic construction.  Barrel and firing pin are made out of high-quality polymer compound, able to weather gunfire significantly better than regular plastic.  Less reliable than its market counterpart, but an effective firearm if you have nothing else available.

variants.description: Possibly the most popular pistol in existence, the Glock 19 can be summed up as being fundamentally a more compact brother to the full-sized Glock 17 pistol.  Sporting a mainly polymer-based design, the Glock 19 is often derided for its plastic construction which lends the handgun a deceptively flimsy feel.  Even so, the Glock 19 remains both a remarkably reliable firearm and a quite shootable gun in its own right.

variants.description: The M1911 was the US Military standard-issue sidearm for most of the 20th Century.  It remains one of the most popular.45 pistols today.

The M45A1 supplanted earlier M45 MEUSOC pistols in use by Force Recon elements of Marine Expeditionary Units.  Where the original M45 pistols were gutted M1911A1s hand-fitted by USMC armorers, the updated M45A1s are hardly different from any other commercial 1911 design, save for their dual recoil springs.  Most were replaced in 2016 with Glock 19s due to logistics issues.
